43north-squire:lever:2eaa0b0c-cf13-4a74-.description: WHO WE ARE SQUIRE is the leading business management system designed for the needs of barbers, shop owners, and their communities. We believe the pursuit of artistry and autonomy should not be restricted by the complexities of running a business. With SQUIRE, we provide custom-branded tools, resources, and guidance to help barbers of all stages and experience levels attract and retain more customers, efficiently manage their shop operations, and increase their revenue. Founded in 2015, SQUIRE is trusted by more than 30,000 barbers across 5,000+ shops in more than a thousand cities worldwide. From streamlined booking and opening new shops to real-time earning dashboards and building lasting customer relationships, SQUIRE supports shop owners in seamlessly bridging the gap between their personal craft and business goals. SQUIRE enables barbers everywhere to unlock their full potential both as artists and as entrepreneurs. For more information, please visit getsquire.com or download the SQUIRE app from the App or Play Store. POSITION TITLE Data Engineer (Snowflake / Systems Integration) SUMMARY The Data Engineer is responsible for building and maintaining the data pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that move data bidirectionally across SQUIRE's business systems: CRM, billing, internal platforms, and our Snowflake data warehouse. This role ensures our data is accurate, accessible, and trustworthy across the company. This person will partner closely with the TechOps and Analytics & Insights teams on cross-system initiatives, dashboards, and data quality work. They will design integrations that keep operational systems and the warehouse in sync, surface internal platform data into downstream CRM and revenue tools, and enable reliable reporting and AI/automation use cases. As part of the Operations extended team, the Data Engineer collaborates across the company. Hiring and technology policies are defined and owned by the Engineering Manager. REPORTS TO Direct: Engineering Manager; Dotted: Operations
responsibilities: ● Design, build, and maintain bidirectional data pipelines between operational systems (CRM, billing, internal platforms, marketing/sales/CX tools) and Snowflake.
● Build integrations that surface data from internal systems back into CRM and other downstream business tools as a reliable source of truth.
● Partner with TechOps and Analytics & Insights on cross-system initiatives: data cleanup, schema changes, new tool rollouts, and reporting/dashboard enablement.
● Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes with clear orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and alerting.
● Model data in Snowflake to support analytics, reporting (Tableau, Looker), and AI/LLM use cases.
● Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and reconciliation logic to catch drift between systems before it reaches end users.
● Translate business definitions into accurate, scalable data structures.
● Audit existing automations and integrations; rip-and-replace where they create duplicate or bad data.
● Build and maintain CI/CD for data pipelines and SQL/transformation code. ● Document data contracts, schemas, and lineage so other teams can self-serve with confidence.
● Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and integration issues across the stack.
● Build and maintain a data dictionary covering key fields, definitions, owners, and source systems, making it easy for any team to understand what data exists, where it lives, and what it means.
The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not a comprehensive list, and additional tasks may be assigned based on business needs.
qualifications: ● 5+ years of experience as a data engineer or in a closely related integration/backend role.

● Strong experience with Snowflake (warehousing, performance tuning, RBAC, Snowpipe/streams/tasks) or equivalent cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Redshift); advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, performance optimization); and Python for data engineering (pandas, requests, API clients, scripting).
● Hands-on experience integrating SaaS business systems (CRM, billing, marketing/sales/CX platforms) via REST APIs, webhooks, and bulk data interfaces.

● Experience with at least one ELT/integration platform (Fivetran, Airbyte, Hightouch, Census, Workato, MuleSoft, or equivalent) and ability to evaluate when to buy vs. build. ● Experience with a transformation framework (dbt strongly preferred) and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar).

● Solid understanding of data modeling (dimensional, normalized, junction objects); familiarity with reverse ETL patterns (warehouse back to operational systems), including Polytomic. ● Practical experience with data quality, deduplication, and master data management (MDM) concepts.
● Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines; strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug across systems, networks, and APIs.
● Excellent communication and collaboration skills; this role works directly with non-technical cross-functional stakeholders.
● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
● English proficiency is required; must be based in Buenos Aires with availability to work on-site in our office in CABA two days a week (Tuesdays and Thursdays).

● Nice to have: Experience with Salesforce data model and APIs, Stripe or similar billing platforms, Gong, marketing automation, or LLM/AI platform integrations, and exposure to data governance frameworks and PII/compliance handling.

a16z-mariana-minerals:ashbyhq:b9f29864-e.description: About Mariana Minerals Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company focused on supplying the minerals critical to modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We are committed to operational excellence, safety, and innovation across all aspects of our business. Position Overview We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Mine Manager to lead all aspects of our surface mining operations. This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective production while driving continuous improvement across drilling, blasting, loading, hauling, maintenance, and support functions. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of delivering measurable cost savings, operational efficiencies, and safety enhancements, while fostering a high-performance, collaborative work culture. This is a hands-on leadership position requiring demonstrated experience in mine expansion, crushing/conveying systems, leach pad stacking, and brownfield & greenfield mine development. The successful candidate will be able to provide specific examples of initiatives that have led to tangible improvements in production, maintenance, operator performance, and personnel development. Key Responsibilities Operational Leadership & Cost Efficiency - Develop and execute mine plans to achieve production targets while optimizing costs. - Lead and document continuous improvement projects (e.g., mine sequencing, haul road design, maintenance strategy changes) with clear ROI and payback periods. - Oversee drilling and blasting operations to maximize fragmentation and minimize costs. - Manage haulage and loading operations to improve cycle times and reduce operating expenses. - Provide specific examples of initiatives that resulted in hard-dollar savings (e.g., improved fleet utilization, reduced downtime, optimized blasting patterns, or fuel efficiency gains).
